entries.zh: 丈量土地长短的尺度；以尺量地、尺度
entries.en: measure of the length of land; a land measure taken with a ruler (chi)
entries.notes: H 栏第三字「省」与 M 栏 cùa 对音不合，疑原稿摹写有误；前二字「尺量」与 L 栏「地之长度的量度」相符。

entries.zh: 量得准、斗面平满（量器合式好用）
entries.en: the measure is a good/true one; a level, full measure (tou, grain measure)
an inch; a measure of one inch

entries.zh: 坐禅、打坐（如僧侣坐禅冥想）
entries.en: to sit in Chan meditation; to meditate as the bonzes do
entries.notes: L 栏 boncos 即 bonzos（僧侣）的 17 世纪拼写。

entries.zh: 〔原件汉字、音写、官话三栏皆空，释义存疑〕medrar＝兴旺、得益、有用；medros＝恐惧、畏惧
entries.en: to thrive, to profit, to be of use (medrar); fear, dread (medros) — Spanish cross-reference only, no Chinese columns in the original
entries.notes: 四栏中仅 L 栏可读，为交叉索引式注记（g. 疑为 igual 之缩写），无汉字可对，据西语义直释。

entries.en: the pulp/flesh of any fruit; or the stone (pit)
entries.notes: H 栏标 [疑:瓤/卵]；M 栏 nū̃ng 与「瓤」相应，且与 L 栏「果之髓或核」义合，故取瓤。

entries.zh: 更、更加；胜过（mejor que＝比…更好）
entries.en: more; better (comparative: mejor que = better than)

entries.zh: 更妙、更为精妙（愈发好、愈发珍贵）
不如、比不得；还是…为好（mejor es＝倒不如）
entries.en: not as good as; better (to) — mejor es = it is better to
entries.notes: L 栏末尾 noyami 形义不明（疑摹写残误）；H、M 二栏一致作「不如」pû̃ xū，据此定释。

entries.en: to recover from illness; to get well
to be restored to health; recovered and well

entries.zh: 气息、呼吸；（病中）气息转好、转安
entries.en: breath; (in illness) to be breathing better, to mend
entries.notes: H「氣息」与 L「mejorar en la salud」仅间接相应（以气息好转指病愈），非直译对等。

entries.zh: 愈有益、渐见彰明（益＝增益，明＝显明）；（凡事）有长进
entries.en: to improve in anything; increasingly beneficial/evident
entries.notes: H「益明」与 L「mejorar en cualquier cosa」属宽泛对应，义据字面推得。

entries.zh: 相思病；因相思而致的忧郁成病
entries.en: lovesickness; melancholy from love, treated as an illness
entries.notes: R 栏「Ho cūa hâu」三音节无法与「病相思」的官话读音对应，来源不明；释义依 H、M 二栏。
